name: agent_rag_intern_en
title: Agent Development Intern
jd_text:
Agent Development Intern
Responsibilities:
- Build AI Agent workflows for resume and job matching products.
- Improve retrieval augmented generation over a vector database and add traceable evaluation reports.
Requirements:
- Python, FastAPI, SQL and basic large language model concepts.
- Experience with tool calling, evaluation and guardrails.
Preferred:
- LangGraph or MCP exposure is a plus, but not required.

name: agent_rag_intern_zh
title: 大模型智能体开发实习生
jd_text:
大模型智能体开发实习生
岗位职责：参与智能体工作流、工具调用和检索增强生成能力建设。
工作内容：维护向量数据库检索链路，记录模型评测指标和异常 trace。
岗位要求：熟悉 Python、FastAPI、SQLite、大语言模型和提示词工程。
任职要求：理解工具调用、模型评测和安全护栏，不夸大没有证据的能力。
加分项：了解 LangGraph 或 MCP，但不是硬性要求。

name: llm_eval_prompt_regression
title: LLM Evaluation Intern
jd_text:
LLM Evaluation Intern
Responsibilities: design model quality dashboards, prompt regression suites and A/B tests for release decisions.
Responsibilities: analyze failure cases and write evaluation summaries for product and engineering teams.
Requirements: Python, SQL, model evaluation, prompt regression and experiment analysis.
Nice to have: React dashboard experience.

name: ml_platform_feature_store
title: ML Platform Engineer
jd_text:
ML Platform Engineer
What you will do: build feature store APIs, model deployment workflow and MLflow experiment tracking.
Responsibilities: maintain FastAPI services with SQLAlchemy, Docker and Kubernetes.
Requirements: Python, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, Feature Store, MLflow, Docker, Kubernetes and MLOps experience.
Preferred: knowledge of React admin panels.

name: backend_api_sqlite_postgres
title: Backend Intern
jd_text:
Backend Intern
Responsibilities: implement FastAPI endpoints, SQLite prototypes and PostgreSQL production migrations.
Responsibilities: add Redis cache, Pydantic validation and SQLAlchemy models.
Requirements: Python, FastAPI, SQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL, Redis, Pydantic and SQLAlchemy.
Preferred: basic Docker usage.

name: frontend_quality_playwright
title: Frontend Engineering Intern
jd_text:
Frontend Engineering Intern
What you will do: build React and TypeScript interfaces for resume review workflows.
Responsibilities: maintain JavaScript components, Playwright smoke tests and A/B testing instrumentation.
Requirements: React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Playwright and A/B Testing.
Nice to have: backend FastAPI familiarity.

name: data_engineering_airflow_spark
title: Data Engineering Intern
jd_text:
Data Engineering Intern
Responsibilities: build Airflow DAGs, Spark jobs and Kafka ingestion pipelines for job-market analytics.
Responsibilities: maintain SQL data marts and Python validation scripts.
Requirements: Python, SQL, Airflow, Spark, Kafka and Docker.
Preferred: exposure to MLflow is optional.

name: recommendation_ranking_ctr
title: Recommendation Algorithm Intern
jd_text:
Recommendation Algorithm Intern
Responsibilities: improve recommendation recall and ranking quality for content feeds.
Responsibilities: analyze CTR movement and run A/B tests with SQL dashboards.
Requirements: Python, SQL, PyTorch, recommendation systems, ranking and CTR analysis.
Nice to have: Spark batch feature experience.

name: ai_security_prompt_injection
title: AI Security Intern
jd_text:
AI Security Intern
Responsibilities: evaluate prompt injection, jailbreak and unsafe tool calling behavior in LLM applications.
Responsibilities: build guardrail tests, model evaluation reports and risk dashboards.
Requirements: LLM, Prompt Engineering, Prompt Injection analysis, Tool Calling, Guardrail and Evaluation.
Preferred: Kubernetes is optional for deployment work.

name: mobile_ai_on_device
title: Mobile AI Engineer
jd_text:
Mobile AI Engineer
Responsibilities: evaluate on-device LLM and computer vision models for mobile scenarios.
Responsibilities: compare PyTorch and TensorFlow model exports and write evaluation reports.
Requirements: Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, LLM concepts, Computer Vision and Evaluation.
Nice to have: React Native experience.

name: computer_vision_opencv
title: Computer Vision Intern
jd_text:
Computer Vision Intern
Responsibilities: build image recognition pipelines and OpenCV preprocessing tools.
Responsibilities: train PyTorch models and track evaluation metrics.
Requirements: Python, Computer Vision, OpenCV, PyTorch and Evaluation.
Preferred: TensorFlow familiarity is a plus.

name: devops_ai_infra
title: AI Infrastructure Engineer
jd_text:
AI Infrastructure Engineer
Responsibilities: operate Docker and Kubernetes services for FastAPI model APIs.
Responsibilities: maintain PostgreSQL, Redis and deployment workflow observability.
Requirements: Docker, Kubernetes, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, Python and Workflow operations.
Nice to have: MLflow is optional.

name: product_analytics_ab_ctr
title: Product Analytics Intern
jd_text:
Product Analytics Intern
Responsibilities: analyze funnel SQL data, CTR movement and A/B tests for product decisions.
Responsibilities: build dashboards and communicate evaluation findings.
Requirements: SQL, Python, A/B Testing, CTR analysis and Evaluation.
Preferred: React charting is optional.

name: rag_retrieval_reranker
title: RAG Engineer
jd_text:
RAG Engineer
Responsibilities: improve retrieval augmented generation with embeddings, cross-encoder reranking and vector search.
Responsibilities: compare FAISS and Chroma stores and write evaluation reports.
Requirements: Python, RAG, Embedding, Reranker, Vector Database, FAISS, Chroma and Evaluation.
Nice to have: LangChain exposure.

name: agent_tooling_node_typescript
title: Agent Tooling Engineer
jd_text:
Agent Tooling Engineer
What you will do: build MCP integrations, tool calling adapters and agent workflow debugging tools.
Responsibilities: maintain Node.js and TypeScript services with Python test harnesses.
Requirements: Agent, MCP, Tool Calling, Workflow, Node.js, TypeScript and Python.
Preferred: React UI work is a plus.

name: negative_context_no_k8s_mlflow
title: RAG Evaluation Intern
jd_text:
RAG Evaluation Intern
Responsibilities: build RAG evaluation scripts and SQL reports for retrieval quality.
Responsibilities: inspect LLM answers and guardrail failures.
Requirements: Python, SQL, RAG, LLM, Evaluation and Guardrail.
Requirements: No prior Kubernetes or MLflow experience required for this internship.
Optional: Docker exposure is helpful but optional.

name: remote_mlops_full_time
title: Remote MLOps Engineer
jd_text:
Remote MLOps Engineer
Responsibilities: maintain MLflow tracking, model deployment workflow and feature store services.
Responsibilities: operate Docker and Kubernetes jobs with Python automation.
Requirements: Python, MLflow, Feature Store, Docker, Kubernetes, MLOps and Workflow.
Preferred: FastAPI API design is a plus.

name: data_engineering_intern_zh
title: 数据开发实习生
jd_text:
数据开发实习生
岗位职责：建设 Airflow 调度任务、Spark 批处理和 Kafka 数据接入链路。
工作内容：使用 SQL 和 Python 做数据校验，维护 Docker 化开发环境。
任职要求：熟悉 Python、SQL、Airflow、Spark、Kafka、Docker。
加分项：了解 MLflow，但不作为必需条件。

name: recommendation_intern_zh
title: 推荐算法实习生
jd_text:
推荐算法实习生
岗位职责：优化推荐系统召回排序链路，分析 CTR 和 A/B实验 指标。
工作内容：使用 PyTorch、Python 和 SQL 训练排序模型并复盘实验结果。
岗位要求：熟悉 推荐算法、排序模型、CTR、A/B实验、PyTorch、Python、SQL。
优先：有 Spark 特征处理经验更好，但不是硬要求。

name: ai_safety_intern_zh
title: 大模型安全实习生
jd_text:
大模型安全实习生
岗位职责：评估大语言模型的提示词注入、越权工具调用和不安全回复。
工作内容：建设安全护栏、模型评测和风险 trace，辅助智能体产品上线。
任职要求：理解 LLM、提示词工程、提示词注入、工具调用、安全护栏、模型评测。
加分项：了解 Kubernetes 部署流程即可，不要求生产经验。

name: fullstack_agent_product
title: Full-stack Agent Intern
jd_text:
Full-stack Agent Intern
Responsibilities: ship React and TypeScript UI for Agent resume review workflows.
Responsibilities: implement FastAPI and SQLite backend services for RAG job evidence retrieval.
Requirements: React, TypeScript, FastAPI, SQLite, Agent, RAG and Playwright smoke tests.
Nice to have: PostgreSQL production experience.

name: langgraph_workflow_engineer
title: LangGraph Workflow Engineer
jd_text:
LangGraph Workflow Engineer
Responsibilities: design Agent state graphs, workflow checkpoints and tool calling loops.
Responsibilities: write Python services that expose debugging traces for long-running agents.
Requirements: Python, LangGraph, Agent, Workflow and Tool Calling.
Preferred: MCP adapter experience is optional.

name: mcp_integration_engineer
title: MCP Integration Engineer
jd_text:
MCP Integration Engineer
What you will do: build MCP servers, tool calling schemas and Agent connector tests.
Responsibilities: maintain TypeScript, Node.js and Python examples for developer adoption.
Requirements: MCP, Tool Calling, Agent, TypeScript, Node.js and Python.
Nice to have: LangChain experience.

name: backend_data_api_no_llm_required
title: Backend Data API Intern
jd_text:
Backend Data API Intern
Responsibilities: build FastAPI endpoints for SQL and SQLite datasets.
Responsibilities: maintain PostgreSQL migrations, Redis cache and Pydantic validation.
Requirements: Python, FastAPI, SQL, SQLite, PostgreSQL, Redis and Pydantic.
Requirements: No LLM experience required; this role supports data APIs, not model development.

name: semantic_search_cross_encoder
title: Semantic Search Engineer
jd_text:
Semantic Search Engineer
Responsibilities: build embedding based semantic search and cross encoder reranking for knowledge retrieval.
Responsibilities: maintain FAISS indexes and vector database sync jobs.
Requirements: Python, Embedding, Reranker, Vector Database, FAISS, RAG and Evaluation.
Preferred: Chroma exposure is a plus.

name: full_time_support_tools
title: Developer Support Tools Engineer
jd_text:
Developer Support Tools Engineer
Responsibilities: build React, TypeScript and Node.js internal tools for support teams.
Responsibilities: query SQL data and write Playwright checks for release quality.
Requirements: React, TypeScript, Node.js, SQL, Playwright and JavaScript.
This is a full-time role.

name: rag_intern_optional_langchain
title: RAG Intern
jd_text:
RAG Intern
Responsibilities: improve retrieval augmented generation quality and write evaluation reports.
Responsibilities: analyze SQL logs and LLM answer failures.
Requirements: Python, SQL, RAG, LLM and Evaluation.
Preferred: LangChain and LangGraph exposure are welcome but not required.

name: search_ranking_feature_store
title: Search Ranking Engineer
jd_text:
Search Ranking Engineer
Responsibilities: improve ranking models, CTR metrics and online A/B tests for marketplace search.
Responsibilities: maintain feature store pipelines with Kafka events and SQL validation.
Requirements: Python, SQL, Ranking, CTR, A/B Testing, Feature Store and Kafka.
Nice to have: PyTorch model training experience.

name: prompt_ops_regression_guardrail
title: Prompt Ops Engineer
jd_text:
Prompt Ops Engineer
Responsibilities: maintain prompt engineering guidelines, prompt regression tests and guardrail review workflows.
Responsibilities: run LLM model evaluation and summarize risky answer patterns.
Requirements: LLM, Prompt Engineering, Prompt Regression, Guardrail, Evaluation and Model Evaluation.
Preferred: Tool Calling experience is useful but optional.

name: cv_pytorch_no_tensorflow
title: Computer Vision Research Intern
jd_text:
Computer Vision Research Intern
Responsibilities: build OpenCV preprocessing and PyTorch training experiments for image recognition.
Responsibilities: report Computer Vision evaluation metrics and failure analysis.
Requirements: Python, OpenCV, PyTorch, Computer Vision and Evaluation.
Requirements: TensorFlow is not required for this project.
